Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

  1. The deviation is established on the field that governs.

    Read the whole claim

    The GPS polyline between the recorded pickup event and the recorded drop-off event measures 27.69 km (trace_distance_km) against a booked optimal of 21.3 km, an excess of 6.39 km — 30.0% of optimal. That clears the 20% limb and clears the 0.8 km limb, so both establishment tests of POL-RD-01 pass and the deviation is ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing measurement and forbids citing the rounded 27.7 km on the trip record in its place; the two straddle nothing here, but the 27.69 km figure is the one the ruling must use.

    EV-GPS-02858, EV-TRIP-02858 · POL-RD-01

  2. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so the measured excess stands and no independent corroboration is required.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-GPS-02858 carries 218 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100.0% coverage and no gap at all between consecutive fixes (max_gap_sec 0.0, gaps list empty). None of limbs (a), (b) or (c) of POL-RD-07 fires: there is no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 seconds. POL-RD-10(3) is therefore not engaged and the trace alone carries the excess.

    EV-GPS-02858 · POL-RD-07, POL-RD-10

  3. The rider's initial burden is discharged under POL-RD-08.

    Read the whole claim

The excess of 6.39 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace, so limb (b) is satisfied and the burden shifts to the driver. The rider's own 60-day counters (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0) are nowhere near the 4-or-more trigger, so POL-RD-08 imposes no additional corroboration requirement on this claim.

    EV-TRIP-02858, EV-GPS-02858, EV-FARE-02858, EV-RPROF-02858 · POL-RD-08

    Read the whole claim

Because the driver names no evidence ID for any advisory, POL-RD-13(1) applies: an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, and the case is ruled rather than escalated.
